out.detail: calf injury; practiced but not expected to play Thursday

away.summary: The Hurricanes (14-3-2) are in Helsinki for the 2026 NHL Global Series, riding strong form as the reigning Stanley Cup champions. Captain Jordan Staal remains out with a calf injury despite returning to full practice, while Mike Reilly, Alexander Nikishin, Nicolas Deslauriers, and Cayden Primeau are scratched. Taylor Hall will mark his 1,000th NHL game, becoming the first player to reach the milestone outside North America.

out.detail: upper-body injury; practiced in a regular jersey but coach Lane Lambert is "not 100 percent sure" he will be ready
upper-body injury; on the trip and practicing in a non-contact jersey

doubtful.detail: upper-body injury; game-time uncertainty per coach Lane Lambert

home.summary: The Kraken (9-6-1) are making their first-ever regular-season appearance outside North America, facing the Hurricanes in Helsinki. The team is dealing with several injuries, including Ryan Lindgren (upper body), Jared McCann (lower body), Jacob Melanson (upper body), and Curtis Douglas (upper body), with Lindgren's status uncertain. Cale Fleury, Jagger Firkus, Logan Morrison, and Nikke Kokko are scratched.
